import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
forms={
 'exp': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]+p[3]*t - p[4]*(1-np.exp(-p[5]*t))*A**2,
 'expQ2': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]+p[3]*t - (p[4]*t/(p[5]+t))*A**2,
 'exp3': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*t)+p[4] - (p[5]*(1-np.exp(-p[6]*t))+p[7]*t)*A**2,
}
for name,f in forms.items():
    n=len(forms[name].__code__.co_consts) 
    best=None
    for s in range(25):
        p0=np.random.RandomState(s).uniform(0.1,2,8)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dA_dt, p0)
        except Exception: continue
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    print(name, np.round(best.x,4), np.sqrt(2*best.cost/len(t))/np.std(dA_dt))
